categories.name: Paddles
categories.description: Every paddle we sell has been played, broken in and argued over in our converted paddle workshop before it reaches you. From 13 mm hand-speed specialists to 16 mm control frames, find the build that fits the way you actually play.
categories.meta_description: Carbon, fiberglass and composite pickleball paddles for control, power and all-court play, tested by players in the Third Shot Supply Co. workshop.

categories.name: Balls
categories.description: Seamless rotomolded balls for outdoor courts, softer 26-hole balls for gyms and a few just for fun. Consistent bounce and true flight, whether you are drilling, playing league night or running a clinic.
categories.meta_description: Seamless 40-hole outdoor and 26-hole indoor pickleballs in packs from 3 to 48. Consistent bounce, true flight and crack-resistant shells.

categories.name: Bags & Covers
categories.description: Backpacks, duffels and covers designed around how players really get to the court. Protect your paddles from heat, grit and scrapes, and keep shoes, balls and bottles where you can find them.
categories.meta_description: Pickleball backpacks, tournament duffels, slings, neoprene covers and hard cases that protect your paddles and keep your gear organized.

categories.name: Apparel & Headwear
categories.description: Caps, visors and sweat-management basics built for long days in the sun. Breathable, understated and comfortable enough to wear well after the last game.
categories.meta_description: Pickleball caps, visors, bucket hats, headbands and wristbands built for sun, sweat and long days on court. Understated and comfortable.

categories.name: Court & Training
categories.description: Nets, rebounders and drill tools for players who improve between matches, not just during them. Set up a court anywhere and practice with purpose, with or without a partner.
categories.meta_description: Portable pickleball nets, rebounders, cones, line kits and footwork ladders for solo practice, clinics and pop-up courts.

categories.name: Accessories
categories.description: The small things that keep your gear playing like new: grips, tapes, cleaning tools and courtside essentials. Simple upgrades, chosen by players who use them every week.
categories.meta_description: Overgrips, replacement grips, edge guard and lead tape, face cleaners, bottles and towels that keep your paddle and game in top shape.

products.name: Kitchen Line Carbon 16
products.short_description: A 16 mm Toray carbon control paddle built for long dink rallies, soft resets and patient points at the kitchen line.
products.description:
The Kitchen Line Carbon 16 is the paddle we reach for when the point is going to be won at the net. A thick 16 mm polypropylene honeycomb core soaks up pace, while the Toray carbon face holds the ball long enough to shape dinks and drops with real intent.

Why players love it

  • Dwell time you can feel. The textured carbon face grabs the ball a beat longer, so roll dinks and topspin drops land where you aimed them.
  • Forgiving sweet spot. Perimeter weighting keeps off-center blocks stable when the hand battle speeds up.
  • Balanced at 7.9 oz. Heavy enough to push through a firefight, light enough to reset late in the third game.
  • Three court-ready colorways. Volt, Coral or Glacier, each with a sealed edge guard and a cushioned 5.25 in grip.

Built for intermediate to advanced players who would rather out-think an opponent than out-hit one. Wipe the face with a damp cloth after outdoor play.
products.meta_title: Kitchen Line Carbon 16 Control Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: A 16 mm Toray carbon control paddle at 7.9 oz for soft dinks, drops and resets. Available in Volt, Coral and Glacier.

reviews.title: My third shot finally behaves
reviews.detail: I play 4.0 doubles three mornings a week and switched from a 14 mm paddle. Drops sit down in the kitchen instead of floating, and resets off hard drives feel calm. It took me a week to trust it on speed-ups.

reviews.title: Great control, a little quiet on drives
reviews.detail: Touch is excellent and the Glacier color looks sharp on court. If you live on driving from the baseline you will notice it is softer than an elongated power paddle. For my game that trade is fine.

reviews.title: Easy on my elbow
reviews.detail: Coming back from tennis elbow, I needed something that did not buzz. This is about as dampened as anything I have tried at our rec center, and the grip size suits my medium hands.

products.name: Apex Elongated 14
products.short_description: An elongated 14 mm raw carbon paddle with extra reach and a crisp, fast response for players who like to finish points.
products.description:
The Apex Elongated 14 trades a little forgiveness for reach, pop and serious spin. Its 16.5 in frame and thinner 14 mm core give drives and overheads a lively, direct feel, and the raw T700 face bites hard on rolled returns.

Why players love it

  • Reach where it counts. The extra half inch of length helps on wide dinks and stretched volleys when your feet cannot quite get there.
  • Raw T700 grit. Unpainted carbon weave generates heavy topspin on serves, drives and counters.
  • Fit your hand. Pick a 4.00, 4.25 or 4.50 in grip circumference; the 5.5 in handle leaves room for two-handed backhands.
  • Head-forward balance. At 8.1 oz with a slightly head-heavy swing weight, it drives through the ball instead of bouncing off it.

Best for confident intermediate and advanced players with sound technique. If you are between grip sizes, go smaller and build up with an overgrip.
products.meta_title: Apex Elongated 14 Power Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Elongated 14 mm raw T700 carbon power paddle, 8.1 oz, with extra reach and heavy spin. Choose a 4.00, 4.25 or 4.50 in grip.

reviews.title: Serves got heavier overnight
reviews.detail: Playing 4.5 outdoors and the spin on serves and rolled returns is legit. The sweet spot is narrower than my old widebody, so blocks need clean contact. Worth the adjustment.

reviews.title: Powerful, but give it time
reviews.detail: Fast and poppy, almost too much for my soft game at first. After two weeks of drilling resets I like it a lot. I went with the 4.25 grip plus an overgrip and it is perfect.

reviews.title: Reach is a real advantage
reviews.detail: I am 6 ft 3 and the elongated shape suits how I cover the middle. The raw face still had plenty of grit after about 40 hours of play.

products.name: Drop Zone Control 16
products.short_description: A widebody control paddle with a carbon and fiberglass face for big sweet-spot forgiveness and soft, repeatable drops.
products.description:
The Drop Zone Control 16 is built around one shot: the third-shot drop. A widebody 8.0 in face puts more paddle behind the ball, and the carbon and fiberglass hybrid skin softens contact without going dead.

Why players love it

  • Biggest sweet spot in the line. The wide face is the most forgiving shape we make, and it shows on off-balance blocks and mishits.
  • Soft without mush. Fiberglass adds a touch of give while carbon keeps feedback clear, so you know exactly how hard you hit it.
  • Stable at 8.0 oz. Centered mass resists twisting when the ball catches the outer edge of the face.
  • Compact handle. A 5.0 in grip suits one-handed players and keeps the hitting surface as large as possible.

A smart pick for 3.0 to 4.0 players building consistency, and for anyone whose game lives on drops and resets. Pair it with a dozen Tour 40 balls and drill until the drop becomes automatic.
products.meta_title: Drop Zone Control 16 Widebody Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Widebody 16 mm control paddle with a carbon and fiberglass face. Big sweet spot, soft feel and repeatable third-shot drops.

reviews.title: Forgiving is an understatement
reviews.detail: I am a 3.5 player and the wide face saves me on rushed blocks. Drops are more consistent than with my old fiberglass paddle. Not much power on drives, which I expected.

reviews.title: Great clinic paddle
reviews.detail: I use it for warmups in the clinics I run at the community courts, and students like how soft it feels. The grip runs a bit short for two-handed backhands.

products.name: Signature Raw Carbon 16
products.short_description: Our flagship: a 16 mm raw T700 carbon paddle in a hybrid shape that blends kitchen touch with real put-away power.
products.description:
The Signature Raw Carbon 16 is the paddle we spent two years tuning in the workshop, and the one most of our own team plays. A hybrid 16.3 x 7.6 in shape and thermoformed raw T700 face give it control at the kitchen and enough drive to end points from anywhere.

Why players love it

  • Thermoformed unibody. Foam-injected edge walls add stability and pop while keeping the 16 mm core quiet and consistent.
  • Raw T700 spin. The unfinished carbon weave grips the ball for heavy topspin rolls, slice serves and dipping drives.
  • True all-court balance. At 8.0 oz with a neutral swing weight, it is quick in hand battles yet solid on blocks.
  • Hand-finished details. Every paddle is weighed, edge-checked and signed off in our workshop before it ships.

Made for intermediate to advanced players who want one paddle that does everything well. Clean the face with our Face Eraser Block to keep the grit working longer.
products.meta_title: Signature Raw Carbon 16 Flagship Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Our flagship 16 mm raw T700 carbon paddle. Hybrid shape, thermoformed build and heavy spin with touch at the kitchen and power from the baseline.

reviews.title: The one that ended my search
reviews.detail: I have demoed a lot of paddles at our club and this is the first one that felt right on dinks and drives. 4.0 level, mostly doubles. Spin on rolls is excellent.

reviews.title: Premium feel, premium price
reviews.detail: Construction is flawless and the hybrid shape is a great middle ground. One star off because the stock grip is a little thin for my hand; an overgrip fixed it.

reviews.title: Worth it on sale
reviews.detail: Picked it up at the special price and it outplays paddles that cost more. I played it through a hot Arizona summer with no dead spots so far.

reviews.title: Solid, not magic
reviews.detail: A very good paddle, but it did not transform my game overnight. Resets are a touch easier than with my old 14 mm. Happy with it, just keep expectations realistic.

products.name: Erne Hybrid 13
products.short_description: A light, fast 13 mm hybrid-shape paddle tuned for quick hands, counters and Erne attacks at the kitchen.
products.description:
The Erne Hybrid 13 is built for the player who lives on the line and likes to take the ball early. A thin 13 mm core and 7.7 oz build make it the quickest paddle in our range, and the carbon and fiberglass face keeps it from feeling jumpy.

Why players love it

  • Fast through the air. Low swing weight means you win more hand battles and recover in time for the next counter.
  • Made for the Erne. Quick, compact swings let you jump the corner and put the ball away before the defense is set.
  • Controlled pop. The hybrid face tames the thinner core, so dinks stay soft while volleys still snap.
  • Hybrid shape. A 16.3 x 7.6 in profile gives a bit of reach without shrinking the sweet spot.

Ideal for aggressive doubles players at the 3.5 level and up. Want more plow-through? Add a few grams of our Lead Tuning Tape at 3 and 9 o'clock.
products.meta_title: Erne Hybrid 13 Fast Hands Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Light 7.7 oz paddle with a 13 mm core and carbon and fiberglass face, built for quick hands, counters and Erne attacks.

reviews.title: Hands got faster
reviews.detail: I play an indoor league at 3.5 and the speed in hand battles was noticeable right away. A little pop-up prone on resets until I learned to soften my grip.

reviews.title: Fun paddle
reviews.detail: Light, quick and Erne shots feel natural with it. I added lead tape at the sides for stability and it is now my main paddle.

products.name: Baseline Power 14
products.short_description: An elongated power paddle with a 14 mm core and Toray carbon face, built for deep drives and big serves.
products.description:
Baseline Power 14 is for players who like to dictate from the back of the court. The 16.5 in elongated frame and slightly heavier 8.3 oz build add plow-through on drives, and the Toray carbon face keeps that power accurate.

Why players love it

  • Plow-through on drives. Extra mass in the head carries pace through heavy, low balls without the paddle twisting.
  • Deep, heavy serves. Length and swing weight work together to push returns back toward the baseline.
  • Accurate Toray face. Consistent carbon response means fewer surprises when you go for the line.
  • Room for two hands. A 5.5 in handle supports two-handed backhand drives and rolls.

Suited to singles players and doubles players who like to drive and attack. It is less forgiving at the kitchen than our 16 mm models, so expect a short adjustment if you play a soft game.
products.meta_title: Baseline Power 14 Elongated Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Elongated 14 mm Toray carbon power paddle at 8.3 oz. Plow-through on drives, deep serves and a long handle for two-handed backhands.

reviews.title: Singles weapon
reviews.detail: I mostly play singles outdoors and the depth I get on drives is impressive. Dinking takes more focus. A strong pick for baseliners.

reviews.title: Heavy but stable
reviews.detail: A bit heavy for me after two hours, but blocks against bangers feel rock solid. I would love a slightly lighter version.

products.name: Dink Club Fiberglass
products.short_description: A friendly fiberglass all-court paddle with a 16 mm core, easy power and a generous, forgiving face.
products.description:
The Dink Club Fiberglass is the paddle we hand to friends who are getting serious about the game. A 16 mm core keeps it controlled, while the fiberglass face adds easy pop, so you do not need a big swing to get the ball deep.

Why players love it

  • Easy depth. Fiberglass flexes slightly on contact and returns energy, helping serves and returns land deep.
  • Controlled core. The 16 mm honeycomb keeps dinks and blocks soft as your game develops.
  • Light at 7.6 oz. Easy on the shoulder and quick in hand without feeling flimsy.
  • Textured finish. A gritted face adds modest spin for rolling dinks and serves.

Great for 2.5 to 3.5 players moving up from a starter paddle, and a reliable backup for anyone. Fiberglass grit wears faster than carbon, so wipe it down after play and store it covered.
products.meta_title: Dink Club Fiberglass All-Court Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: A 16 mm fiberglass all-court paddle at 7.6 oz with easy power and a forgiving face. The ideal step up from a starter paddle.

reviews.title: Perfect step up
reviews.detail: Moved up from a wood paddle at our park courts and this feels like a different sport. Light, forgiving and easy on my shoulder.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.detail: At this price it plays well above its class. Spin is moderate and the grit wore a little after a couple of months outdoors. Still my go-to.

products.name: Rookie Rec Composite
products.short_description: A durable widebody starter paddle with a polymer composite face, ideal for new players and family court time.
products.description:
Rookie Rec Composite is where a lot of our players start. The wide polymer composite face is forgiving and tough, and at 7.4 oz it is light enough for anyone to swing all afternoon.

Why players love it

  • Forgiving widebody face. An 8.0 in wide hitting surface makes it easy to get the ball back while you learn.
  • Built to take knocks. The composite face and sealed edge handle concrete scrapes and garage storage.
  • Comfortable grip. A cushioned 5.0 in handle with a sweat-absorbing wrap stays secure in summer heat.
  • Honest price. Good enough to learn proper technique, affordable enough to buy a pair.

Made for beginners, school programs and rec play. When you are ready for more touch and spin, the Dink Club Fiberglass is the natural next step, and the Rookie becomes a great loaner for friends.
products.meta_title: Rookie Rec Composite Beginner Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Durable 7.4 oz widebody beginner paddle with a polymer composite face and cushioned grip. Built for new players, families and rec play.

reviews.title: Bought four for the family
reviews.detail: We set up a court in the driveway and these have survived kids, concrete and a dog. They play fine for rec games.

reviews.title: Good beginner paddle
reviews.detail: Learned with this at a community center clinic and it was easy to hit with. After a few months I wanted more spin and upgraded, but it is now my loaner.

reviews.title: Does the job
reviews.detail: Basic but solid. It is louder off the face than carbon paddles, which bothers my neighbors more than me.

products.name: Junior Spark Youth Paddle
products.short_description: A lighter youth paddle with a shorter grip and soft control face, sized for young players ages 7 to 12.
products.description:
Junior Spark is a real paddle scaled for smaller hands, not a toy. A 15.5 in frame, 4.5 in handle and 7.3 oz build help young players swing with proper form from day one.

Why players love it

  • Sized right. The shorter grip and slimmer circumference let kids hold a continental grip without strain.
  • Light and soft. A 13 mm polymer core keeps the ball controllable, so rallies last longer than two shots.
  • Tough edges. A rubberized edge guard shrugs off court scrapes and dropped-paddle moments.
  • Confidence builder. Bright graphics and an easy feel keep young players coming back to the court.

Recommended for ages 7 to 12, or for players under about 5 ft tall. Pair it with a Rookie Rec Composite and a few Tour 40 balls for a parent and child set that gets the whole family on court.
products.meta_title: Junior Spark Youth Pickleball Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: A lighter 7.3 oz youth paddle with a 4.5 in grip and soft 13 mm core, sized for young players ages 7 to 12.

reviews.title: My 9-year-old loves it
reviews.detail: It fits her hand perfectly and she can actually rally with us now. I wish it came in more colors.

reviews.title: Good size for kids
reviews.detail: Bought two for our summer camp. Solid build for the price, though one edge guard scuffed quickly on asphalt.

products.name: Classic Ash Wood Trainer
products.short_description: A heavy laminated ash wood trainer that builds timing, footwork and a clean contact point.
products.description:
Before carbon and honeycomb, there was wood, and it is still one of the best teachers on the court. The Classic Ash Wood Trainer weighs 10.5 oz and has a small sweet spot, so it rewards early preparation and punishes lazy contact.

Why players love it

  • Builds strength. Training with a heavier paddle makes your match paddle feel quick and light.
  • Honest feedback. Mishits sting a little, which is exactly how you learn to find the center.
  • Classic craft. Seven-ply laminated ash, 13 mm thick, with a lacquered finish and a leather-look wrap.
  • Nearly indestructible. Ideal for schools, drill sessions and living in the car trunk.

For drilling, warmups and players who love the old-school feel. Ten minutes of dinking with it before you switch paddles is a classic coaching trick. Not recommended for players nursing arm injuries.
products.meta_title: Classic Ash Wood Training Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: A 10.5 oz laminated ash wood training paddle that builds timing, strength and a clean contact point. A classic drill tool for every level.

reviews.title: Old-school drill tool
reviews.detail: Our coach has us do 10 minutes of dinks with this before switching to our real paddles, and my touch is noticeably better. Heavy, as advertised.

products.name: Coach's Weighted Trainer
products.short_description: A raw carbon training paddle with removable weight bars that adjust it from 8.0 oz to 9.6 oz for strength and tempo drills.
products.description:
The Coach's Weighted Trainer is the tool we use in our own clinics to slow swings down and build compact, repeatable mechanics. Two removable steel weight bars slide into the edge channel, taking the paddle from 8.0 oz to 9.6 oz in seconds.

Why players love it

  • Adjustable load. Run drills at full weight, then pull the bars for a match-feel warmup without changing paddles.
  • Real paddle face. A raw T700 carbon surface and 16 mm core play like a premium paddle, so your feel carries over.
  • Better mechanics. Extra mass exposes wristy swings and rewards using your shoulder and legs.
  • Clinic tough. A reinforced edge channel and locking screws stand up to daily coaching use.

For coaches, serious improvers and anyone rebuilding strength after a layoff. Start with short sessions: 15 minutes at full weight is plenty at first.
products.meta_title: Coach's Weighted Training Paddle | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Raw T700 carbon training paddle with removable weight bars, adjustable from 8.0 to 9.6 oz, for strength, tempo and mechanics drills.

reviews.title: Clinic staple
reviews.detail: I run three clinics a week and we use two of these for tempo drills. The bars swap fast and have never loosened. Pricey for a trainer, but very well made.

reviews.title: Wish there were a middle setting
reviews.detail: Love the concept. I would like a half-weight option between 8.0 and 9.6 oz. The face plays just like a regular carbon paddle.

products.name: Court Ready Starter Set
products.short_description: Everything a new player needs in one box: your choice of paddle, Tour 40 balls, a neoprene cover and optional overgrips.
products.description:
The Court Ready Starter Set takes the guesswork out of getting started. Pick the paddle that fits your game, add balls and a cover, and you will be on court the day the box arrives. Every piece is the same gear we sell individually, nothing made down to a price.

Why players love it

  • Choose your paddle. Start with the Rookie Rec Composite, or step up to the Dink Club Fiberglass or Drop Zone Control 16.
  • Balls included. Add a 3-pack or a 12-pack of our seamless Tour 40 outdoor balls.
  • Protect it. A neoprene cover in Forest, Optic or Clay keeps the paddle face clean in your bag.
  • Grip it your way. Add a 3-pack of Tacky Overgrips if you play in heat or like a slightly thicker handle.

A thoughtful gift for a new player, or a quick upgrade for anyone still borrowing gear at the park. Everything ships together in one box.
products.meta_title: Court Ready Pickleball Starter Set | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Build your starter set: choose a paddle, Tour 40 balls and a neoprene cover, with optional overgrips. Everything a new player needs in one box.

attributes.material: Bundle: paddle, Tour 40 balls, neoprene paddle cover, optional overgrips
attributes.dimensions: Ships in one 18 x 10 x 4 in box

reviews.title: Perfect gift
reviews.detail: Bought this for my dad's 65th birthday with the Dink Club paddle. Everything arrived well packed and he was playing at the senior center that same week.

reviews.title: Convenient bundle
reviews.detail: An easy way to get set up. I wish there were a two-paddle option for couples, but the pricing made sense.

products.bundle_note: Dynamic price: the total is the sum of the paddle, ball pack, cover and any overgrips selected. The default build (Rookie Rec Composite, Tour 40 3-Pack, Forest cover) comes to $105.

products.name: Tour 40 Outdoor Ball, 3-Pack
products.short_description: Our seamless 40-hole outdoor ball in a 3-pack: true flight, consistent bounce and built to resist cracking.
products.description:
The Tour 40 is the ball we built our drills around. Rotomolded in one seamless piece, it measures 74 mm with 40 precisely drilled holes, giving it steady flight through wind and a consistent bounce on hard courts.

Why players love it

  • Seamless construction. No weld line means no soft spot, so every bounce feels the same.
  • Tournament-style specs. 40 holes, 74 mm diameter and about 26 g, in line with outdoor competition balls.
  • Crack resistant. A tuned polymer blend holds its shape longer on cold mornings and hot afternoons.
  • High visibility. Optic yellow pops against blue, green and sand-colored courts.

Sized for a weekend game or a few spares in your bag. Store balls out of direct sun and away from freezing temperatures to extend their life.
products.meta_title: Tour 40 Outdoor Pickleball Ball, 3-Pack | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Seamless rotomolded 40-hole outdoor pickleball ball, 74 mm, with true flight and consistent bounce. Optic yellow, 3 per pack.

attributes.material: Seamless rotomolded polyethylene

reviews.title: Lasts longer than my old brand
reviews.detail: We play on rough concrete and these lasted about three weeks of regular play before going soft. That beats what we used before.

reviews.title: Consistent bounce
reviews.detail: No lopsided bounces, even on the windy days we get by the lake. Good ball.

products.name: Tour 40 Outdoor Ball, 12-Pack
products.short_description: A 12-pack of Tour 40 seamless outdoor balls for regular groups, leagues and drill sessions.
products.description:
The 12-pack is how most of our regular groups buy the Tour 40. It is the same seamless 74 mm, 40-hole ball, packed in a resealable box that keeps a season of open play organized.

Why players love it

  • Better value per ball. Stock up for league nights and stop rationing your last good ball.
  • Same ball, every ball. Rotomolding keeps weight and bounce consistent across the whole box.
  • Wind-steady flight. Precisely drilled holes help the ball hold its line outdoors.
  • Resealable box. Keeps fresh balls clean and together until you need them.

A smart buy for clubs, ladder organizers and anyone who plays three or more times a week. Rotate fresh balls into play as older ones lose their bounce, and keep the box out of a hot car.
products.meta_title: Tour 40 Outdoor Pickleball Ball, 12-Pack | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Twelve seamless 40-hole Tour 40 outdoor balls in a resealable box. Consistent bounce and steady flight for leagues, groups and drills.

attributes.material: Seamless rotomolded polyethylene

reviews.title: Our club's ball now
reviews.detail: Our ladder group of 20 switched to these. Durability is good and nobody complains about the bounce. The sale price made it an easy call.

reviews.title: Good, a couple cracked early
reviews.detail: Most lasted well, but two cracked in the first week during a cold snap. Customer service replaced them quickly.

reviews.title: Great for drilling
reviews.detail: I use the 12-pack for solo serve practice. Consistent flight and easy to see.

products.name: Tour 40 Practice Bucket, 48 Balls
products.short_description: 48 Tour 40 outdoor balls in a sturdy lidded bucket, made for clinics, ball-machine sessions and team drills.
products.description:
Coaches asked for a better way to buy in bulk, so we built the Practice Bucket. It holds 48 Tour 40 seamless outdoor balls in a lidded, stackable bucket with a carry handle.

Why players love it

  • Clinic-sized supply. Enough balls to keep a drill line moving without constant pickup breaks.
  • Ball-machine friendly. Consistent size and weight help machines feed smoothly.
  • Tough bucket. A UV-stable bucket with a snap lid survives trunks, garages and courtside sun.
  • Same Tour 40 performance. Seamless, 74 mm and 40 holes, matching what your players use in games.

Built for coaches, clubs and serious solo drillers who hit hundreds of balls a week. Pair it with a Ball Retriever Tube to spend less time bending and more time hitting.
products.meta_title: Tour 40 Practice Bucket, 48 Balls | Third Shot
products.meta_description: 48 seamless Tour 40 outdoor balls in a lidded, stackable bucket. Built for clinics, ball machines and team drills.

attributes.material: Seamless rotomolded polyethylene, UV-stable plastic bucket

reviews.title: Clinic essential
reviews.detail: I run four beginner clinics a week and this bucket gets used every session. The lid stays on in the trunk. I wish it had wheels.

products.name: Gym 26 Indoor Ball, 6-Pack
products.short_description: A softer 26-hole indoor ball in a 6-pack, tuned for gym floors and controlled, longer rallies.
products.description:
Indoor play needs a different ball. The Gym 26 has 26 larger holes and a slightly softer shell, so it grips wood and sport-court floors and slows down just enough for long, tactical rallies.

Why players love it

  • Indoor-tuned bounce. A softer polymer shell keeps the ball from skidding on smooth gym floors.
  • 26-hole pattern. Larger holes reduce speed and make the ball easier to control in tight spaces.
  • Quieter play. Softer contact is welcome in community centers and shared gyms.
  • Easy to track. A bright Volt shell stands out against wood floors and painted walls.

Made for indoor leagues, school gyms and winter play. Not recommended for outdoor courts, where rough surfaces wear the softer shell quickly.
products.meta_title: Gym 26 Indoor Pickleball Ball, 6-Pack | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Softer 26-hole indoor pickleball ball tuned for gym floors, quieter play and longer rallies. Volt, 6 per pack.

attributes.material: Soft-touch rotomolded polymer

reviews.title: Best indoor ball we have tried
reviews.detail: Our church gym league switched to these this winter. The bounce is true on the wood floor and they are holding up well.

reviews.title: Good, slightly slow
reviews.detail: Plays a touch slower than I like, but that suits our mixed-level group. Good durability so far.

products.name: Twilight Glow Ball, 3-Pack
products.short_description: Glow-in-the-dark 40-hole outdoor balls for dusk sessions and dimly lit courts, sold in a 3-pack.
products.description:
Some of the best games happen as the sun goes down. Twilight Glow balls use a photoluminescent finish that charges under daylight or court lights and glows softly as the light fades.

Why players love it

  • Charges fast. About 10 minutes in sunlight or under a bright lamp gives a useful glow for casual play.
  • Real outdoor ball. Seamless rotomolded construction with 40 holes, so it plays close to a standard Tour 40.
  • Easier to track at dusk. The glow helps you follow the ball through the last half hour of light.
  • A little fun. A favorite for backyard courts, summer camps and evening socials.

Best for casual and social play. Glow brightness depends on charge time and fades over 20 to 30 minutes, and it is not a substitute for proper court lighting.
products.meta_title: Twilight Glow-in-the-Dark Ball, 3-Pack | Third Shot
products.meta_description: Glow-in-the-dark 40-hole outdoor pickleball balls with a photoluminescent finish for dusk sessions and backyard courts. 3 per pack.

attributes.material: Rotomolded polyethylene with photoluminescent finish

reviews.title: Backyard hit
reviews.detail: Our evening driveway games last an extra half hour now. The glow fades after 20 minutes or so, but a quick recharge under a flashlight helps.

reviews.title: Fun, feels a bit firmer
reviews.detail: The kids love them. They feel a touch harder off the paddle than the regular Tour 40 to me.

products.name: Tour 40 Pink Edition, 6-Pack
products.short_description: Tour 40 outdoor balls in a pink colorway, 6 per pack, with a portion of every sale donated to breast cancer research.
products.description:
The Tour 40 Pink Edition is the same seamless outdoor ball our players trust, in a bright pink shell. For every pack sold, we donate a portion of the proceeds to a nonprofit supporting breast cancer research.

Why players love it

  • Same proven ball. 74 mm, 40 holes and seamless rotomolded construction for steady flight and bounce.
